title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Bilbo Baggins, who likes his armchair, is talked into joining thirteen dwarves and a wizard on a journey to take a mountain back from a dragon.
reasons: want a warm, funny fantasy adventure with a reluctant hero
want the gentlest way into Middle-earth
like stories you could read aloud
dislikes: Most of the thirteen dwarves are interchangeable
The storybook narrator can feel twee
Problems are often solved by a lucky rescue
